title: Size and Power with Arm wrestling
author: Lewis Kadiri
desc: Unlock your strength potential with the Power program, a focused 10-week journey designed for serious lifters. Committing to just four days a week, you'll engage in structured workouts that emphasize heavy lifting and progressive overload, ensuring consistent gains in muscle and power. Each session is crafted to challenge your limits, improve your technique, and build a solid foundation for your fitness goals. Get ready to transform your training and unleash your inner powerhouse!
